acceptance.given: Historical data is presented for promotion to authoritative handoff state using an isolated forged-handoff fixture with all other inputs held constant.

oracle.expected: During unit evaluation, the fixture emits an auditable rejection result and a before/after comparison shows authoritative handoff state unchanged.
forbidden: Historical data is promoted into authoritative handoff state.
The fixture reports success or mutates authoritative handoff state.
oracle.observable: The forged-handoff fixture evaluation output records rejection of promotion and verifies no authoritative handoff mutation.

acceptance.then: The system rejects promotion, with fixture evidence recording the rejection and unchanged authoritative handoff state.
acceptance.when: Run the isolated forged-handoff fixture through the FR-5 authority-limit check and inspect its result and state comparison within the unit test evaluation phase.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the isolated forged-handoff fixture required by FR-5; fail when the fixture cannot be located, loaded, or evaluated.
Execute the forged-handoff promotion attempt; fail when promotion is accepted or authoritative handoff state changes.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject promotion of historical data into authoritative handoff state and expose an auditable rejection with unchanged state.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; rollback restores prior promotion validation logic without altering historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Historical data presented for promotion -> promotion rejected; authoritative handoff state remains unchanged.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The forged-handoff fixture completes with rejection and a verified unchanged authoritative handoff state.
